text: ADVANCE. One trigger: buy stop 1 tick over bar_high 644.24, trailed to each new prior-day high (C27). MA is a POSITION-system picture: new high, structure_shift ABOVE_STRUCTURE, from_52w_hi 0.0%, elder_pattern ACCELERATION. In that system the break above resistance IS the entry (C26); a pull-in to ma_20 is my swing system's dip and not this name's picture. The red last bar is answered by the order itself: a stop over its high fills only if the market takes the high back. If it never trades, no fill and the stop trails. Wrong if it trades under the red bar's low (C14).
